title: If you stop, you die
description: If you stop moving for more than a few seconds... YOU DIE!
body:
### A simple datapack that adds a simple challenge - JUST KEEP MOVING!
You have to keep moving or else you will start to take damage and die!

### If there are issues with the datapack, type /reload in chat!

Go watch this [video](https://youtube.com/shorts/pMqsKej1U5s?feature=share) for a brief showcase.


Let me know if you need this for a specific version and I will upload it. Also feel free to use this in your content, I just ask that you provide credit.
